comments.author: RogueTech67
comments.body_html: What is a traitor scav, and under what game play circumstance are they found?

comments.author: acidphantasm
comments.body_html:
When you play as a scav there is a 15% chance that a traitor scav spawns. This scav will shoot you on sight, but you can kill them to gain some fence rep.

This mod disables them, or allows you to change their spawn chance.
